Alec is described as having lovely, curly, black hair.

## History

During Anne's time in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), Alec fetched [Janet](../character/janet.md) following the passing of John Douglas's mother. This allowed John to arrive shortly after and propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md), revealing that his mother had previously forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) is a romantic suitor competing for the marriage of Alec. During a pleasant fortnight spent together in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) in Volume 3, they explore Alec's birthplace and visit her parents' old home and graves. Through this time together, which includes Alec receiving and reading her parents' old love letters at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly), Alec gains a deep connection to her family's past.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P12](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0012), +2 more_
